sections.heading: Playing Strategies
sections.wikitext:
﻿'''Gar-Ghoul:Gothic Terror''' is best used when he is in combat. Thanks to his aggression ability, he is really good at fighting heroes with high attack but low low defense. If he is attacked, he can be protected with combat actions like [[TCG:SAS-124|Stalemate]] or [[TCG:SAS-121|Poisonfang]].﻿
